name: Glass
source:
"Autumn---, in that afternoon classroom---, I fell in love with her at first sight."

Autumn in a certain school, Sakurai Kazushi (Main Protagonist) was called over to the classroom after school by their class president Shirakawa Yui. After being subjected to a harsh sermon, he somehow ended up being challenged by her to a match. Sakurai reluctantly accepts, but somehow their conversation ended up taking an unexpected turn…

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ145985.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“秋天——那天下午的教室里——我对她一见钟情。”

某所学校的秋日，樱井和志（主人公）放学后被班长白川由衣叫到教室。他遭到严厉说教，不知为何又被她挑战。和志不情愿地接受，谈话却意外转向……

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ145985.html]DLsite English[/url]]
